system.description: Incorporating the target's hair, spittle and blood into a personal talisman, the oneiromancer crafts a Dream Catcher that grants its owner a two-Trait bonus to resist hostile spirit attacks. The oneiromancer who crafted it gains a two-Trait bonus when using her path upon the owner, while rival oneiromancers suffer a two-Trait penalty against him. The effect lasts until the talisman is lost, stolen or destroyed. (Oneiromancy)
